AETOS Office Assistant

Open the add-in in Word, choose Model connection, and save your endpoint and model. Endpoints must implement chat completions with SSE or JSON and permit browser requests from this add-in’s origin.

No proxy is included. Your API key is visible in settings and saved unencrypted in browser local storage. Do not use shared browser profiles for private credentials.

Select text for Rewrite or Summarize, or place your cursor for Draft. Review and edit the Markdown suggestion before inserting or replacing. Discard cancels acceptance; it cannot recall information already transmitted.

This is a preview release. Cross-platform host verification, column selection detection, atomic edits and Undo guarantees remain open. Consult docs/PARITY.md and docs/HOST-TESTS.md in the source package.
